title: Imparfait Formation - All Verbs (was doing, used to do)
description: Learn to form imparfait for ALL verbs using the 'nous stem' rule: je parlais (I was speaking/used to speak), il faisait beau (it was nice), on allait (we used to go)
can_do: Form imparfait for any French verb (was doing, used to do)
Describe ongoing past actions and habits
Use the 'nous stem' rule to conjugate all verbs

vocabulary.gloss: I was speaking / I used to speak
we were going / we used to go
I was playing / I used to play
I was taking / I used to take

concepts.definition: Take the {nous} form of the present, drop -ons and add the imparfait endings. Every verb works this way except {être}.

examples.fr: Je parlais français tous les jours.
examples.en: I used to speak French every day.

concepts.definition: Start from the present {nous} form of the verb.
Take off the -ons, and what is left is the stem. The stem of {nous faisons} is fais-.

examples.fr: Je prenais le bus tous les jours.
examples.en: I used to take the bus every day.

examples.fr: On allait au café chaque samedi.
examples.en: We used to go to the café every Saturday.

concepts.definition: The endings are the same for every verb. Four of the six forms sound the same.
{être} uses the stem ét- instead. The endings are the same.
Use it to describe how things were and what you used to do.

examples.fr: Quand j'étais jeune, je jouais avec mon chien.
examples.en: When I was young, I used to play with my dog.

examples.fr: Il y avait beaucoup de gens.
examples.en: There were a lot of people.
She used to work a lot.

items.gloss: I used to speak French every day

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habits: je parlais (I used to speak).
That's present tense! Use imparfait: je parlais (I was speaking/used to speak).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{je}' form: je parlais (not parlions).
That's passé composé! Use imparfait for description: il faisait beau.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: il faisait (it was).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{il}' form: il faisait (not faisions).

items.gloss: We used to go to the café every Saturday

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habits: on allait (we used to go).
That's present tense! Use imparfait: on allait (we used to go).
On uses il/elle form! Use '{on allait}', not 'allions' (which is nous).
That's passé composé! Use imparfait for ongoing desire: je voulais.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: je voulais (I wanted).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{je}' form: je voulais (not voulions).
That's passé composé! Use imparfait for description: il y avait.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: il y avait (there were).
'{Il y a}' uses singular form! Use '{il y avait}', not 'avions'.

items.text: Je ___ le bus tous les jours
items.gloss: I used to take the bus every day

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habits: je prenais.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: je prenais (I used to take).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{je}' form: je prenais (not prenions).
That's passé composé! Use imparfait for state: nous étions.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: nous étions (we were).
That's '{je}' form! Use '{nous}' form: nous étions (not étais).

items.gloss: Where were you? / Where did you use to live?

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for state: tu étais où?
That's present tense! Use imparfait: tu étais (you were).
That's il/elle form! Use '{tu}' form: tu étais (not était).

items.gloss: She used to study French at school

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habits: elle étudiait.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: elle étudiait (she used to study).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{elle}' form: elle étudiait (not étudiions).

items.gloss: They used to go to the park / They were going to the park

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habits: ils allaient.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: ils allaient (they used to go).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{ils}' form: ils allaient (not allions).

items.gloss: Did you want coffee? / Were you wanting coffee?

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for ongoing state: vous vouliez.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: vous vouliez (you wanted).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{vous}' form: vous vouliez (not voulions).

items.gloss: We used to do our homework each evening

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habits: on faisait.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: on faisait (we used to do).
On uses il/elle form! Use '{on faisait}', not 'faisions'.

items.text: Je ___ au café quand tu m'as appelé
items.gloss: I was going to the café when you called me

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for ongoing action: j'allais.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: j'allais (I was going).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{je}' form: j'allais (not allions).

items.gloss: They used to live in a big apartment

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for ongoing past state: ils habitaient.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: ils habitaient (they used to live).
That's '{nous}' form! Use '{ils}' form: ils habitaient (not habitions).

items.gloss: She used to work a lot

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habits: elle travaillait.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: elle travaillait (she used to work).

items.gloss: When I was young, I used to play with my dog

mistakes.feedback: That's passé composé! Use imparfait for description: j'étais jeune.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: j'étais (I was).
That's il/elle form! Use '{je}' form: j'étais (not était).
That's passé composé! Use imparfait for state: nous étions fatigués.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: nous étions (we were).
That's passé composé! Use imparfait for habit: tu étais toujours en retard.
That's present tense! Use imparfait: tu étais (you were).
